nodes.description: Current sale price of the Canvas NFT, read and mutated in buy() and read in poll().
Immutable Pixel ERC20 token address used for pricing, burning and pool share calculations.
Arbitrary string metadata written by setInfo() (hodler only) and read by poll().
Current owner of the single NFT; used as payout target in buy(), access check in setInfo() and returned by poll().
Approved spender for the single NFT, set in approve()/_transferBase() and returned by poll().
owner => operator => bool approval mapping used by _transfer() and setApprovalForAll().
Canvas constructor: stores Pixel token, derives initial price from totalSupply and transfers NFT to the Pixel contract.
External payable buy(): validates msg.value == price, refunds hodler share via low-level call, raises price by 50% and transfers the NFT.
External redeem(amount): pulls Pixel tokens, burns them and refunds ETH share to msg.sender via low-level call.
External setInfo(info_): only the current hodler may update the info string.
View helper returning hodler, allowed, price, pool balance, user share and info.
Pure function returning the off-chain JS renderer source as a constant string.
Internal _transferBase(to): emits Transfer, updates hodler and clears allowed.
Internal _transfer(from,to,tokenId): authorization checks then calls _transferBase.
External transferFrom: delegates authorization to _transfer.
External safeTransferFrom: calls _transfer then invokes ERC721 receiver hook when the target is a contract.
External approve: hodler/operator gated approval of a single token id.
ERC20 permit: timestamp-bounded EIP-2612 signature approval using ecrecover and owner nonce.
Internal _mint: increases totalSupply and recipient balance with an overflow require.
Internal _burn: decreases totalSupply and holder balance with a balance require.
ERC20 transfer(to,amount): moves msg.sender balance to recipient.
ERC20 transferFrom(from,to,amount): spends allowance and moves balances.
msg.sender controls buy/redeem/setInfo/approve/transferFrom paths and receives ETH refunds.
block.timestamp compared against the permit deadline (timestamp dependency).
Low-level call{value: hodler_share, gas: 20000} to hodler inside buy(), executed before state finalization (reentrancy surface).
Low-level call{value: share, gas: 20000} to msg.sender inside redeem() after external token calls (reentrancy surface).
External calls pixel.safeTransferFrom and pixel.burn in redeem(), trusting the token contract.
info_ string parameter of setInfo().
amount parameter of redeem(), controls ETH share and burn size.
user address parameter of poll(), used for Pixel balanceOf and share math.
_approved/_operator parameter of approve()/setApprovalForAll().
hodler_share local in buy(), the ETH amount forwarded to the previous hodler.
success flag returned by the low-level call in buy(); deliberately unchecked.
share local in redeem(), computed from contract balance and Pixel totalSupply.
success flag of the low-level call in redeem(), enforced with require.

edges.reason: msg.sender's value is used in buy() as the new hodler and event participant.
msg.sender is the payer of Pixel tokens and receiver of ETH in redeem().
setInfo() gate require(msg.sender == hodler) authorizes the caller.
transferFrom() authorization depends on msg.sender being hodler, allowed or operator.
approve() gate compares msg.sender with hodler/operators.
permit() validity is bounded by block.timestamp < deadline, a timestamp dependency.
buy() performs an external low-level ETH call to the untrusted hodler before updating price and hodler.
redeem() performs an external low-level ETH call to msg.sender after token interactions.
redeem() invokes external Pixel safeTransferFrom and burn on the token contract.
The computed hodler_share value flows into the low-level call performed in buy().
price is read, compared with msg.value and multiplied by 150/100 inside buy().
Price state is part of the contract value accounting touched by redeem().
poll() returns the current price.
The Pixel token address is compared with hodler to decide the payout share in buy().
redeem() uses pixel.totalSupply(), safeTransferFrom and burn.
poll() calls pixel.balanceOf(user) for share computation.
setInfo() writes the info state variable.
poll() returns the info string.
hodler is the external call target and payout recipient inside buy().
redeem() does not use hodler directly but shares the value-accounting state.
hodler is the authorized caller required by setInfo().
poll() returns the hodler address.
poll() returns the allowed spender address.
_transfer() checks operators[hodler][msg.sender] for transfer authorization.
_transfer() calls _transferBase(to) after all checks pass.
transferFrom() delegates to _transfer().
safeTransferFrom() delegates to _transfer() before the receiver hook.
safeTransferFrom() invokes the ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received hook on the recipient contract.
The amount parameter drives the ETH share and token burn inside redeem().
amount is used to compute the share local variable in redeem().
The user parameter is passed to pixel.balanceOf in poll().
The info_ parameter is stored into the info state variable.
redeem() triggers _burn(amount) which decrements totalSupply and balance.
buy() transfers the NFT to msg.sender via _transferBase().
The computed share amount flows into the low-level ETH call in redeem().

normalization_plan.reason: The info_ parameter only serves as input to setInfo() and should be folded into that function node.
The amount parameter exclusively feeds redeem() arithmetic and token burn.
The user parameter is only consumed by poll() for balance and share computation.
The _approved/_operator parameter only parameterizes the approve/setApprovalForAll operations.
hodler_share is a transient intermediate of buy() and is directly consumed by the low-level payout call.
The unchecked success flag belongs to buy()'s low-level call handling.
share is a transient intermediate of redeem() feeding the ETH payout.
The success flag is used only to require() the result of redeem()'s low-level call.
